stories.title: October inflation report at 8:30am ET, after Waller backs a December hike
stories.summary: The US consumer price report for October comes out Tuesday at 8:30am ET (20:30 Bangkok). Earlier today Fed Governor Waller said he still supports a rate increase in December and that a bigger one should be considered if prices run hot. Because October 2025 prices were never collected during the government shutdown, the monthly numbers are what to watch.
points: Consensus is +0.3% for the month (September +0.6%) and core +0.2% (September +0.3%), per CoinDesk; FactSet's estimate for the headline is +0.2%, per CoinDesk's week-ahead.
Waller said he would support a 25 basis point increase in December and that a 50 basis point move should be considered if October core inflation runs hot, per Investing.com.
After his speech, CME FedWatch odds of a December hike rose from 76.3% to 96.3%, per Cointelegraph.
September's last official yearly rates were 3.7% headline and 2.6% core, per CoinDesk.

stories.title: Bitcoin and ether funds keep losing money; forced selling calms down
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin and ether funds had net outflows again on Monday, and BlackRock's bitcoin fund has now had seven straight days of redemptions. The wave of forced selling of leveraged bets has eased since Monday.
points: Monday 9 Nov: US spot bitcoin ETFs -$201M net, led by BlackRock's IBIT at -$213.2M, per CoinDesk.
Monday 9 Nov: US spot ether ETFs -$184.6M net, per CoinDesk.
Over $1.2B of positions were liquidated on Monday, $1.04B of them bets on higher prices, per Coinglass via KuCoin News.
Liquidations then fell about 84% to $184M, per CoinDesk.

stories.title: MSCI decides Wednesday on Strategy; its bitcoin is now worth less than it paid
stories.summary: On Wednesday MSCI announces whether it will drop crypto-treasury companies like Strategy from its indexes, which could force index funds to sell the stock. Strategy kept buying bitcoin last week, but with bitcoin below its average cost its holdings are now under water on paper.
points: Strategy bought 1,036 BTC for $81.9M at an average of $79,012 each, per The Block.
It now holds 850,364 BTC bought for about $64.2B, an average of $75,456 each, per The Block.
With bitcoin near $74,650 when Blockhead published on Tuesday, those holdings were below cost, per Blockhead.
MSCI results come shortly after 11:00pm CET on Wed 11 Nov, with changes effective at the close on 30 Nov, per MSCI.
JPMorgan estimated about $2.8B of selling in Strategy shares if it were removed, or up to $8.8B if other index providers followed, per DL News.

breaking.title: US consumer prices rose faster than expected in October
breaking.summary: The CPI rose 0.4% in October and the core rate 0.3%, above forecasts of 0.3% and 0.2%; no yearly rate was published because October 2025 data was never collected. Bitcoin extended losses, falling about another 1% to around $73,600 after the 8:30am ET release.
